close_reason: Adopted option 1 (doc-only) per the bead's recommendation and the workspace's existing pub-Map precedent. Workspace AGENTS.md extras-preservation policy section now carries an explicit 'Caller contract — wire-key collisions' sub-section documenting the foot-shooting scenario, the underlying serde-flatten non-dedup behavior, and the explicit caller contract ('callers must not insert keys into extra whose name matches a typed field on the same struct'). Added in-tree regression test extra_collision_with_typed_field_round_trip_fails on EmailAddress that locks in the observable behavior (serialize emits two keys; deserialize rejects with 'duplicate field'). The test uses string-level oracle (matches count) not the code under test, and will fail loudly if a future serde release silently alters the contract. Per-field rustdoc unchanged (every extra field already says 'Catch-all for vendor/site/private extension fields not covered by the typed fields above'); the workspace AGENTS.md is the single source of truth so propagation to sibling crates is automatic. Option 2 (accessor/newtype) explicitly rejected as out-of-scope: it would require revisiting the workspace policy + jmap-types::MethodResponseError.extra precedent across 30+ crates.
title: pub `extra` field allows wire-key collisions with typed fields — produces non-round-trippable duplicate-key JSON
